verdict.rationale: Kit's API documents per-broadcast stats covering recipients, opens, clicks, and unsubscribes with rates, plus per-link click performance, batch stats across a page of broadcasts, and account-level email and growth stats over a time period with 5-year retention. Nothing in the evidence shows per-automation or per-sequence-step metrics, conversion attribution, or time-series breakdowns per campaign. Missing for 10: per-automation-step analytics, conversion metrics per campaign, per-campaign time-series trends, independent or hands-on corroboration.
